name: gemini-advisor
description: Multi-model selective routing for Antigravity: Pro plans, Flash builds, and fresh Pro gives unbiased reviews while burning fewer tokens.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate Pro for planning, Flash for building, and fresh Pro for unbiased reviews.
interface.longDescription: Gemini Advisor is a capability-routed software delivery plugin for Antigravity. It uses Gemini Pro for intent, architecture, and contracts, delegates routine implementation to fast and economical Gemini Flash, and routes diffs to a fresh, unbiased read-only reviewer to maximize quality and minimize token burn.
